pr_title: planner: enable column pruning for common handle
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #22642

Problem Summary:

In https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/18391, we skipped common handles when doing the column pruning for simplicity, this caused some unnecessary table read when reading index is enough.

### What is changed and how it works?

1. enable column pruning for common handles (see changes in rule_column_pruning.go)
2. add common handles to tablescan's schema when it's the double read case (find_best_task.go)
3. do not add a projection above PhysicalIndexLookupReader if we did the agg pushdown (task.go)
4. also add common handles to tablescan's schema in the index merge join when it's the double read case (exhaust_physical_plans.go)

Note: In this PR, all columns in the common handle are always read in the table worker of index lookup reader no matter whether it requires to keep order or not. This can be improved after resolving https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/23037

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test


### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- no release note.
